title: SAMPLE LAYERS -- six sounds, each played as endless long random grains

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Drop an audio file onto a slot's waveform to load it (six slots).
MASTER on / off: starts all layers with a fade-in; off fades them out.
attack ms / release ms: length of that master fade-in and fade-out.
taper ms: soft fade at the start and end of every grain (shared by all slots).
volume: master level, with stereo meters. Click the speaker to start audio.
Each slot: on / off toggle, gain dial, and min ms / max ms for grain length.
Each new grain picks a random length in that range (default 3000-8000 ms).
The highlighted area on each waveform is the grain playing now.

sections.heading: AS A BPATCHER
lines: sample-layers-slot.maxpat: argument 1 = buffer name (slot1 ... slot6), unique per slot.
Inlet 1: slot on/off (0/1). Inlet 2: slot gain 0.-1. Outlets: grain audio L and R.

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: Each slot's gen~ plays one grain at a time and starts the next the moment it ends.
Every grain gets a random start point, length and stereo position.
The slots are summed into a master gen~ that applies the attack/release fade.
